name: Université de Strasbourg
summary: Large research university in Strasbourg, on the German border; licences are taught in French, many with courses in English and German.

ib.text: EU/EEA nationals with the IB apply for a bachelor's (licence) through Parcoursup. First-year licences list French among their teaching languages.

lastYear.text: wishes 19 January–12 March; confirm by 1 April

notes: Unistra's list of 'bachelor's degrees taught in English' names licences taught in French with English (and often German), such as European Law and the CPES tracks.
The one licence taught only in English, International Economics and Management, is a third-year entry after two years of study.
